description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source project and contains code for importing test cases from Mantis XML issue data. It includes functions for processing XML data, importing test cases, handling file uploads, and managing import options, integrated within a web interface.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class representing a user in TestLink, used for managing user data during test case import.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class used for managing test cases, including creation, updating, and duplication checks.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class for management of test projects within TestLink, used for retrieving project-specific configurations.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class for managing and traversing the hierarchy of test case containers.

classes.name: tlString
classes.description: Utility class for string operations specific to TestLink's requirements.

methods.name: importIssueFromXML
methods.description: Imports test cases from an XML file, returning a map of results.

methods.name: saveImportedTCData
methods.description: Processes and saves imported test case data into the database, handling duplicates and validation.

methods.name: getTestCaseSetFromIssueSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts test case data from a simplified XML object structure into an array suitable for import.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI-related data structures for the import interface, including file paths and UI labels.
